chapter.title: The Upside-Down Card
chapter.body:
The lamp above the desk buzzes once, then settles.

You are early. The incident room is still cold, and nobody else has arrived.

On the corkboard, one card has been pinned upside down. You are almost sure it was the right way up last night.

You turn it over. The handwriting is small and neat. It is a list of times, and every time is four minutes past the hour.

A [[lantern]] burns low on the far windowsill. Someone sat here before you did.

You copy the list into your own notebook. Then you pin the card back exactly as you found it.

Down the corridor, the radiator ticks. The building is waking up.

clueTap.prompt: One word on that card is doing the work. Want to try it?
